name: A specialization switch from the talent window hands the action bars back to the client
contract: Switching specialization through a known-entries upload (CMSG 0x727) runs SwitchSpecialization without restoring a stored build. It sends SMSG_ACTION_BUTTONS state 2, which clears the client's bars, and the client accepts no bar changes until a state-1 list follows; without one, nothing can be placed on the bars until the next login.

Button 0 holds Attack (6603), so a state-1 list starts with the dword 0x0019CB01 (1690369) and is counted as that packet row; the 1-byte state-2 packet is not. The switch from Fleshweaver (25) to Sanguine (26) must be followed by at least one state-1 list, and Attack stays on button 0.
